step_name: Profile validation against locked ground truth corpus
what_was_done: Locked 7-case ground truth before simulation, constructed deterministic patch stubs, executed all runs, generated TP/FP/FN comparison matrix, computed precision/recall with honest catchability accounting, and prepared PM sign-off artifacts.
success_criteria_met: Ground truth locked before simulation and replayable
Simulation ran on all 7 stubs and produced deterministic outputs
Comparison matrix covers all 7 entries with explicit TP/TN/CLEAN reasons
False blocking on accepted patches remained 0 (<2 threshold)
All Phase 3 artifacts generated as parse-valid JSON
success_criteria_not_met: Recall >= 0.70 could not be measured because only one catchable rejected objection existed in corpus
blockers: Ground-truth corpus is too small for statistically stable recall (catchable_objections=1).
deviations_from_plan: Phase 3 verdict set to INSUFFICIENT_DATA per methodology rules instead of PASS/FAIL.
next_step: Phase 4 READY_TO_START with conditions: expand catchable rejected corpus before promoting new blocking heuristics.
notes: Advisory only; no source modifications and no network calls were made during Phase 3 validation.
